known_geometry_properties.scope: Harmonica-based Core property inversion, independent volume-integral data; exact known cube geometry, not free-voxel recovery

public_joint_workflow.scope: Exact public mesh/inputs; deliberately three iterations; checks artifact completion and honest nonconvergence, not full recovery

public_linear_resolution.parameterization: Eight fixed spatial octants of original active mesh; uniform g/cm3 coefficients, not free voxel covariance

large_operator.scope: Analytic diagonal precision stress test; not a geophysical regional sensitivity/runtime benchmark

limits: Published dataset is synthetic, not a field survey. Raw inputs are not redistributed.
Voxel data fit and independent prediction do not imply unique property/body/vector recovery.
Linear Gaussian diagnostics condition on fixed noise, forward, beta and regularization; no nonlinear/IRLS/bound posterior claim.
evidence_scope: Public synthetic and authored 3D geometry; operator/physical checks and declared conditional recovery. No field certification or universal geological recovery.
